sense: a person between thirteen and nineteen

pins.definition: A young person who is developing from a child into an adult.
A young person between thirteen and nineteen years old.
A young person between roughly twelve and seventeen years old.

situation: A boy stands against a suburban kitchen wall while his mother holds up a pair of trousers that now sit far above his ankles.
subject: the sudden growth spurt
brief: A fifteen-year-old boy in a bedroom doorway looks down self-consciously at his bare ankles projecting far out of jeans that are suddenly much too short for him. His mother stands beside him holding a measuring tape, looking up at him with an amused, astonished expression as she realizes he has outgrown another pair of clothes.
